result.summary: Found 1 visually broken content issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section heading.

issues.description: The section title above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of user-facing text.
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization lookup or add the missing translation so the heading renders a proper label, such as "Popular" or the intended localized equivalent.
